messages.author: 07446e536e285021
messages.subject: Access to files with Rapache
parts:
Dear colleagues!
I try to run a R script from Rapache and I have this error

###############################################################
RApache Warning/Error!!!
In file(file, "r") : cannot open file '/home/luis/world.asc':
Permission denied
###############################################################

where world.asc is a raster map imported to R with the function
import.asc (package adehabitat)

world <- import.asc("/home/luis/world.asc")

Does anybody knows what is going wront? I feel that I have to give
permissions to Rapache to read and write files in my hard disk,
but...where and how?

Thanks in advance...

Luis R.

messages.author: 417414441a0ca1d9
messages.subject: Re: Access to files with Rapache
parts:
This is almost certainly a simple Unix user permissions issue. The
rapache process - i.e., the httpd process -- is being run as some user,
probably httpd or apache. That user has to be able to read the file.

A simple way to deal with that is

$ chmod g+r /home/luis/world.asc

See man chmod for what that means.

messages.subject: Re: Access to files with Rapache
parts:

parents are not globally readable.
